verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an `async` parameter: setting it to `true` submits a search without holding the HTTP connection open, and results are retrieved later through the Searches Archive API. This directly delivers asynchronous job submission, which the story accepts as an alternative to batching. High-volume tiers such as Cloud 1M (1,000,000 searches/month) support the volume side. Missing for 10: no batch/bulk submission endpoint, no documentation of async throughput limits or job-status polling detail, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of async at scale.
